name: Cultist
text: A robed fanatic with a knife and a prayer.

name: Masked Acolyte
text: A tall figure in a smiling porcelain mask. It moves like a dancer.

name: Ghoul
text: Dog-faced and rubbery, it smells of opened graves.

name: Wendigo
text: Antlers, ribs, and a hunger that never ends. It hunts across great distances.

name: Drowned One
text: A sailor, bloated and grey, who should not still be walking.

name: Tide Crawler
text: Shell plates and too many legs, dragging itself up from the shallows.

name: Hound of the Angles
text: It pours out of the corner of the room. It has followed you through time.

name: Night Swarm
text: A cloud of black wings and needle teeth.

name: Hollow Priest
text: Its robes are full. The rest of it is not.

name: Sand Wraith
text: A shape of blowing sand with a voice like a dry well.

name: Grave Revenant
text: It crawled out of its coffin and it is angry about something.

name: Star Leech
text: A glowing worm the size of a man. It feeds on thought.

name: Witch of the Hollow
text: She lives where three roads meet and keeps her heart in a jar.

name: Shapeless Hunger
text: A mass of black jelly that remembers being something else.

name: Pallid Mask
text: A white mask floating at head height. There is no face behind it, and there is no need for one.

name: Spawn of the Deep
text: A green mountain of flesh with a crown of feelers. It is only the herald.

name: The Unseen Twin
text: You see only its footprints, each one as wide as a cart, and you hear it calling for its father.

name: The Smiling Stranger
text: A tall, handsome man in a black suit, with a pharaoh's bearing and eyes like burnt holes. He is delighted to meet you.

name: Phantom of Truth
text: A figure in tattered yellow robes. It wears no mask, and that is the worst thing about it.

name: The Dreamer, Risen
text: It fills the sky over the drowned city. You cannot fight it. You can only keep it busy.
